chunks: If the subjects suspect you of high-handedness,

explain to them your position openly, and remove their suspicion with your explanation, because this would mean exercise for your soul and consideration to the subjects while this explanation will secure your aim of keeping them firm in truth.

key_terms.إِصْحَارٌ: open explanation or making something clear
key_terms.الرَّعِيَّةُ: the subjects or people under governance

ai.seo_question: How should a Muslim governor handle public suspicion of injustice?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) instructs Malik al-Ashtar to preemptively justify his decisions to the populace, transforming governance into a form of spiritual discipline (riyada) that bridges the gap between ruler and ruled. This proactive transparency not only demonstrates mercy (rifq) but also serves as a necessary means of establishing legitimacy and guiding the community toward justice, reflecting the Shia ideal of the just ruler who is accountable to his subjects.

en.sayed-ali-raza: If the subjects suspect you of high-handedness,

explain to them your position openly and remove their suspicion with your explanation, because this would mean exercise for your soul and consideration to the subjects while this explanation will secure your aim of keeping them firm in truth.
